name: Common Codification v2.0
description: QC-01 to QC-40 for a curated tabular export (CSV). Compiled from the codification framework without partner mappings or the issues log.

rules.rule: subject_id present, matches pattern DSnn-XXXXXXXX and is unique in 'subject'.
No direct identifiers (national ID, name, e-mail, phone, address, hospital number, staff initials) in any column.
Column names equal the catalogue variable names, plus optional <variable>_dar and <variable>_comparator companion columns; no other columns.
File is UTF-8, comma-separated, dot decimal separator, header row, no merged cells.
Every value is in the named value set or is a FHIR DataAbsentReason code.
Only 1, 0 or empty.
Only numbers; no units, '<', '>' or text in the cell. Censored values: number in the variable, comparator (<, <=, >=, >) in <variable>_comparator.
Integer; plausible window (-3650 to 7300 days).
Follow-up day >= 0 (after index date).
colonoscopy_day >= 0 and colonoscopy_planned_day >= colonoscopy_referral_day.
0-120; dataset ranges: DS01 20-76, DS02 >= 18.
Height 100-250 cm; weight 30-250 kg.
12-70; if height and weight present, |BMI - weight/height^2| <= 1.
1.0-3.0; agrees with the stated formula within 0.05 m2.
Indexed value = absolute value / BSA within rounding (<= 1 unit or 5%).
5-90 and within 2 percentage points of (EDV - ESV) / EDV x 100.
ESV < EDV.
Within CDE range (4_CDE_Catalogue); values of 0 checked for being missing codes.
0.10-0.70; values 10-70 indicate percent -> divide by 100.
egfr_equation filled (or stated in metadata).
If hpv_hr_dna_cobas_result = pos, triage genotype results are expected (else _dar).
Must be filled when cervical_cytology_day_followup is filled, and vice versa.
Allowed only with figo_staging_system; 'I-IV' substages must belong to that system.
figo_stage empty/'not-applicable' when tumour_behaviour = 0 (benign).
Only when treatment_pathway = nact_icrs.
0 or empty unless treatment_pathway = nact_icrs.
Integer 0-39.
pfs_months <= os_months; pfs_event present when pfs_months present.
If deceased, os_months is the time to death (event).
Germline and somatic status consistent (a germline pathogenic variant is usually also detected in tumour testing).
If cce_polyp_detected = 0 then count = 0 or 'not-applicable'; if 1 then count >= 1 and equals number of lesion rows.
Same logic as QC-31 for colonoscopy.
0.5-150 mm; numeric.
invasive_carcinoma <-> polyp_histology = carcinoma; crc_* filled only then.
start < end; both <= recording length x 60.
0-100; if both slider and paper values exist, slider is used.
0-4 after recode; total computed only if all 10 items present.
Filled only when work_absence_* = 1.
Only records with 1 exported.
Combinations of quasi-identifiers (age, sex, site, country of birth, rare diagnosis) with fewer than 5 persons are flagged for generalisation.
